description: Two fresh find-only demonstration missions using the unchanged v36 Jev planner/controller and established eight-room geometry. Hidden workshop target from entry (5811), entry target from workshop (5812). One objective: enter the destination room, find the red item using observations, and make a valid stationary inspection report. No return objective. Preserve both outcomes. Rank strict audit-clean successes first, then verified inspection, fewer contacts/rule violations/false reports, then completion time and path length. These are selected demonstration trials, not a reliability estimate. Fixed 1200 simulated seconds/$3.50 per trial and existing wall watchdog; no policy tuning during the batch.
